name: 葡萄牙高技能活动居留许可
nameEn: Portugal highly qualified activity residence permit
summary: 面向在葡萄牙从事受雇或独立高技能活动，并持相应居留签证及资格、合同等证明的人士。
summaryEn: For people undertaking employed or independent highly qualified activity in Portugal with the relevant residence visa and evidence of qualifications and activity.

visa.summary: 通常须持有用于高技能活动的有效居留签证。
visa.summaryEn: A valid residence visa for highly qualified activity is normally required.

qualification.summary: 须提供学历证书或专业专长证明。
qualification.summaryEn: A qualification certificate or evidence of professional specialisation is required.

activity.summary: 受雇者须证明合同和适用薪酬；独立活动者须提供服务合同、公司或经营活动证明。
activity.summaryEn: Employees must evidence the contract and applicable remuneration; independent workers must evidence services, a company or registered activity.

sources.authority: Portugal Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum (AIMA)
sources.title: Residence permit for highly qualified activity — Article 90

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
